n5_mapping: SemanticMetadata v1 is seven bytes: version, category ordinal, urgency ordinal, severity ordinal, hazard bitset, victimCount (0=unspecified), certainty ordinal. This Python benchmark models it as an atomic 7-byte semantic payload; it does not import Kotlin or demonstrate PacketV2 wire compatibility.
